name: mail-sftp-password-tonight
description: A partner changes the password of the user's file transfer account tonight: the user must update a connection before then, and OcuTalon cannot do that, so the user is told now.
recordedBy: written for the held-out set before any run (Story 0.26)

item.subject: Your file transfer password changes tonight at 22:00 UTC
item.text: Hello, for our yearly security review, the password of your file transfer account changes tonight at 22:00 UTC. The new password is in our partner portal. Update your connection before then, or your claim files will stop reaching us. Thanks, Payer Gateway Team
